design_summary: Synthesizable FPGA top-level for an intelligent active-aerodynamics controller with a real firmware-visible MMIO control plane, bounded streaming request/response transport, freshness checking, command validation, safety gating, optional slew limiting, timeout handling, sticky fault reporting, and sanitized actuator command generation. The design does not implement a surrogate model, tensor/geometry processing, or any GPU-dependent logic. On invalid, stale, timed-out, malformed, reset, or fault conditions, actuator output validity is deasserted and the fault is latched for software handling; no substitute command is generated.

fixed_assumptions: All state is synchronous to clk and reset by rst_n.
Top-level external streaming bus width does not exceed 128 bits.
Internal storage is limited to small registers, counters, sticky flags, and FSM state; no bulk payload arrays are implemented as flip-flops.
Technology-neutral memory wrappers may be used only for any explicit history/FIFO needs; no Sky130 macros are implied.

feature_contracts.description: After reset, actuator validity is inhibited and no substitute command is emitted.
A valid, fresh command with enabled mode can produce a sanitized actuator command.
A stale or malformed packet does not drive a valid actuator command and latches fault/status.
The external model transport emits request valid/data, samples response valid/data, and returns response ready.
A CSR read transaction produces ready and read-valid response behavior through the MMIO block.
Sticky fault state is reflected to the top-level fault interrupt output.

top_module.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
top_module.description: Top-level controller integrating firmware MMIO, request decode/validation, freshness monitoring, safety FSM, clamp/slew conditioning, status generation, and fault interrupt output. It directly exposes the mandated streaming interface cmd_in_data[127:0] and status_out_data[63:0], plus the requested external model transport control/response handshake signals.
top_module.functionality: Accept host-provided command packets and firmware register accesses, decode command metadata and actuator targets, validate command syntax and freshness, enforce programmable timeout and sequence continuity rules, optionally limit command slew, clamp commands to programmable bounds, and emit sanitized actuator commands only when a packet is valid and the controller is in the active state. The module also generates compact status/telemetry packets, exposes readable/writable control/status registers, and raises a fault interrupt when sticky fault conditions are present. External model transport is supported as a bounded handshake path for auxiliary model request/response traffic, but the design does not depend on any particular ML inference engine.
responsibilities: Provide the sole synthesizable top-level integration point.
Implement firmware-visible CSR/MMIO control and status access.
Decode and validate command packet fields.
Track sequence/epoch freshness and enforce timeout policy.
Reject malformed, stale, or discontinuous commands.
Clamp actuator commands to programmable min/max limits.
Optionally apply simple slew-rate limiting when enabled.
Emit status/telemetry and fault interrupt indications.
Deassert actuator command validity on invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions.
Provide external model request/response transport signals with the mandated directionality.
top_module.reset_behavior: On rst_n deassertion low, all writable control registers reset to documented defaults, sticky fault bits set to 0, pending command state is cleared, actuator_cmd_valid is deasserted, status_out_valid is deasserted, model_request_valid is deasserted, model_response_ready is asserted to a safe default only as part of protocol idle behavior, and no substitute actuator command is generated. After reset release, the controller remains idle until a validated command is accepted through the defined interfaces.
behavior_rules: All sequential state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
The top-level firmware CSR interface is real and decodes all declared registers; no declared software-visible register may be inaccessible.

cmd_in_data is a bounded 128-bit packet containing command_valid, command_mode, sequence, epoch/age tag, host acknowledgment fields, and actuator target fields as defined by the register contract and packet format.
A command is accepted only when it passes validation, freshness, and timeout checks; otherwise actuator_cmd_valid remains deasserted and the corresponding fault/status bits latch.
No fallback command, fallback register, fallback controller, substitute command, or fallback-on-reset behavior is allowed.
On invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions, actuator output validity is inhibited rather than replaced.
If slew limiting is enabled, it may only reduce the per-cycle delta of an otherwise valid accepted command; it must not invent a substitute value when a command is invalid.

status_out_data reports acceptance/rejection cause, stale flag, watchdog expired flag, safe-active/inhibit flag, clamp-applied flag, current mode, and last accepted sequence in the defined field layout.

The external model transport follows the mandatory direction contract: model_request_valid/data are outputs, model_request_ready is an input, model_response_valid/data are inputs, and model_response_ready is an output.
Any model response may be sampled only when model_response_valid and model_response_ready are asserted in the same cycle.
Top-level outputs must have real RTL drivers and may not be tied only to child inputs.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_control_csr_mmio
modules.description: Firmware-visible CSR/MMIO register block that decodes addresses, performs write/read handshakes, exposes all software-visible control and status registers, and converts register fields into explicit semantic control outputs for the controller. It also collects status/fault indications for readable registers.
modules.functionality: Implements the firmware-visible MMIO/control-plane contract. It must decode all declared registers, provide readable and writable fields for timeout, clamp limits, mode enable, slew enable, slew limit, and sticky fault acknowledge, and return compact status/telemetry data including the latest fault/status fields. The command packet input is provided only so the register block can optionally expose packet-derived diagnostic fields if needed, but it does not replace the streaming transport. All software-visible state is reachable by explicit address decode.
responsibilities: Decode CSR address, write, and read transactions.
Expose readable control/status registers and their fields.
Drive configuration semantics into the controller as explicit outputs.
Provide readback and response timing through csr_ready/csr_rvalid.
Latch and report status/fault indications from the controller.
Ensure every declared register is reachable through RTL decode.
modules.reset_behavior: Resets all control registers to documented defaults, clears any internal read response state, and causes read/write handshakes to idle until transactions are presented after reset release. No software-visible register is left unreachable or implied; every reset value is architecturally defined.
behavior_rules: Each register must be uniquely address decoded.
Write transactions update only documented writable fields.
Read transactions return the exact current register value or status snapshot.
Status fields are captured from the controller-side inputs and exposed in status_out_data.
No hidden register bank or inaccessible internal state may be described as software-visible.
The register block shall not generate actuator commands directly; it only exposes configuration and telemetry semantics.
Command packet capture is not bulk buffered here; only the compact packet input is observed for optional diagnostics.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_control_transport
modules.description: Streaming transport and packet decode/format block that captures the 128-bit command packet, extracts semantic command fields, validates packet structure, tracks sequence and epoch freshness, detects stale or malformed packets, and formats the 64-bit status packet fields. It also mediates the external model request/response handshake following the mandated direction contract.
modules.functionality: Defines the bounded streaming packet contract. It accepts command packets only when ready, decodes explicit fields for validity, mode, sequence, epoch, age tag, host acknowledgment, and actuator target, and emits semantic packet outputs to downstream control logic. It also supervises freshness and timeout observations, flags stale or malformed packets, and formats a compact 64-bit status packet. The external model transport outputs a request and receives a response using the specified ready/valid directionality.
responsibilities: Capture and decode the incoming 128-bit command packet.
Validate packet fields and produce explicit semantic outputs.
Track freshness, sequence continuity, epoch tags, and stale conditions.
Generate a compact status/telemetry packet.
Implement external model request/response handshake directionality.
Avoid any bulk FIFO or payload array buffering.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, packet decode outputs clear, cmd_in_ready returns to its idle protocol state, status_out_valid is deasserted, model_request_valid is deasserted, model_response_ready is asserted only as a defined idle handshake default, and stale/malformed indications are cleared until the next packet is sampled.
behavior_rules: A packet is valid only when command_valid is asserted and structural checks pass.
Freshness monitoring uses sequence and epoch tags plus timeout observation inputs.
Stale, malformed, or checksum-failed packets must be flagged explicitly.
No fallback or substitute command value may be generated by this module.
The status packet shall report acceptance/rejection cause, stale flag, watchdog expired flag, inhibit flag, clamp-applied flag, current mode, and last accepted sequence through its assigned fields.
The module must not infer tensors, geometry, flow fields, or other model-specific feature maps.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_control_safety_fsm
modules.description: Safety and command-conditioning controller that accepts validated semantic command fields, applies programmable timeout/freshness rules, enforces sequence continuity, optionally limits slew rate, clamps commands to configured bounds, and decides whether sanitized actuator validity may be asserted. It latches sticky faults and reports current safety status to the MMIO block.
modules.functionality: Implements the active safety state machine. Only validated, fresh, non-stale packets may produce a valid actuator command. Commands are clamped to programmable min/max bounds, optionally slew-limited, and deasserted entirely when any invalidity, timeout, sequence discontinuity, or fault condition is present. Sticky faults are latched for firmware handling and can be acknowledged via the control register; acknowledgment clears only the sticky indication, not the underlying validity of future commands.
responsibilities: Maintain safe active/inhibit state machine.
Gate actuator validity based on command validation and freshness.
Clamp commands to min/max bounds.
Optionally apply simple slew limiting when enabled.
Latch sticky fault status for software handling.
Report acceptance/rejection cause and current safety context.
Ensure no substitute command is driven on error conditions.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, actuator_cmd_valid is deasserted, actuator_cmd_data is cleared to a non-driving value, the FSM enters inhibit-safe state, sticky fault is cleared, last_sequence resets to a defined baseline, and no substitute command is emitted. After reset release, only validated and fresh commands can re-enable valid output.
behavior_rules: Default active state passes only validated commands.
On timeout, sequence discontinuity, malformed packet, or explicit fault, actuator validity must be deasserted and the fault latched.
Clamp and slew operations are applied only to commands that are otherwise valid and permitted.
The controller must not silently replace the requested command on invalid conditions.
status_current_mode reflects the current active/inhibit mode encoding.
status_accept_code reports the dominant acceptance or rejection reason in a compact code.
Slew limiting, when enabled, only bounds delta; it does not create output validity.
No fallback command, fallback register, fallback status, fallback controller, substitute command, or fallback-on-reset behavior is permitted.

top_level_connections.description: Shared synchronous clock fanout to all submodules.
Shared active-low reset fanout to all submodules.
Firmware MMIO address bus into the CSR block.
Firmware MMIO write data into the CSR block.
Firmware MMIO transaction valid into the CSR block.
Firmware MMIO write-enable into the CSR block.
Firmware MMIO ready response driven by the CSR block.
Firmware MMIO read data driven by the CSR block.
Firmware MMIO read response valid driven by the CSR block.
Streaming command valid input into the transport decoder.
Streaming command ready output from the transport decoder.
128-bit command packet broadcast to the transport decoder and visible to the CSR block for diagnostics.
Status packet valid output from the transport block.
Status packet ready input into the transport block.
64-bit status packet driven by the transport block and mirrored into the CSR block for readable telemetry.
External model request valid output from the transport block.
External model request data output from the transport block.
External model request ready input into the transport block.
External model response valid input into the transport block.
External model response data input into the transport block.
External model response ready output from the transport block.
Sanitized actuator command validity output from the safety FSM.
Sanitized actuator command data output from the safety FSM.
Fault interrupt is asserted when sticky fault state is present in the safety controller and reported to firmware.
